   292→    /// Returns an `EnrForkId` for the given `slot`.
   293→    pub fn enr_fork_id<E: EthSpec>(
   294→        &self,
   295→        slot: Slot,
   296→        genesis_validators_root: Hash256,
   297→    ) -> EnrForkId {
   298→        EnrForkId {
   299→            fork_digest: self
   300→                .compute_fork_digest(genesis_validators_root, slot.epoch(E::slots_per_epoch())),
   301→            next_fork_version: self.next_fork_version::<E>(slot),
   302→            next_fork_epoch: self
   303→                .next_digest_epoch(slot.epoch(E::slots_per_epoch()))
   304→                .unwrap_or(self.far_future_epoch),
   305→        }
   306→    }

   308→    /// Returns the `next_fork_version`.

   310→    /// `next_fork_version = current_fork_version` if no future fork is planned,
   311→    pub fn next_fork_version<E: EthSpec>(&self, slot: Slot) -> [u8; 4] {
   312→        match self.next_fork_epoch::<E>(slot) {
   313→            Some((fork, _)) => self.fork_version_for_name(fork),
   314→            None => self.fork_version_for_name(self.fork_name_at_slot::<E>(slot)),
   315→        }

   318→    /// Returns the epoch of the next scheduled fork along with its corresponding `ForkName`.

   320→    /// If no future forks are scheduled, this function returns `None`.
   321→    pub fn next_fork_epoch<E: EthSpec>(&self, slot: Slot) -> Option<(ForkName, Epoch)> {
   322→        let current_fork_name = self.fork_name_at_slot::<E>(slot);
   323→        let next_fork_name = current_fork_name.next_fork()?;
   324→        let fork_epoch = self.fork_epoch(next_fork_name)?;
   325→        Some((next_fork_name, fork_epoch))
   326→    }

   333→    /// Returns the name of the fork which is active at `epoch`.
   334→    pub fn fork_name_at_epoch(&self, epoch: Epoch) -> ForkName {
   335→        let forks = [
   336→            (self.gloas_fork_epoch, ForkName::Gloas),
   337→            (self.fulu_fork_epoch, ForkName::Fulu),
   338→            (self.electra_fork_epoch, ForkName::Electra),
   339→            (self.deneb_fork_epoch, ForkName::Deneb),
   340→            (self.capella_fork_epoch, ForkName::Capella),
   341→            (self.bellatrix_fork_epoch, ForkName::Bellatrix),
   342→            (self.altair_fork_epoch, ForkName::Altair),
   343→        ];

   352→        }
